fieldValues.title: Action in Semantic engineering in practice
fieldValues.summary: Energy direction: getting things done (Act) vs developing how we get things done (Observe). The current battle. The owner's localisation of the classic axis (vignette 'Evolving the axes', 2026-10-24). The poles are the classic poles, which the owner affirmed on 2026-10-22; yang is the classic yang. For the owner to judge in relation.
